module: Flowgraph node "Spawn Prefab" (author BeamNG, behaviour once). Loads a prefab (.prefab.json or old .prefab) at a position via spawnPrefab, adds it to the MissionGroup and registers it in the flowgraph prefab module. Inputs: flow, reset, resetVeh, path, name, pos, useGlobalTranslation, silent. Outputs: flow, created (impulse), id, origVehId (player vehicle before spawn), success.
notes: The prefab's objects are not deleted by this node: the prefab module takes care of it at the end (except Keep Prefab).
Loading a prefab with vehicles changes the player's vehicle; origVehId allows finding it again.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

init.desc: Initializes the object list and origPositions.

postInit.desc: Restricts the path pin to .prefab.json and .prefab files.

createObject.desc: Resolves the path (with possible extensions), creates the prefab (canSave = false), puts it in MissionGroup and in modules.prefab; on failure, objects = {'failed'}.

clearObjects.desc: Empties the object list (without deleting the prefab from the scene).

work.desc: Handles reset (forgets the prefab), resetVeh (restores the vehicle positions) and creates the prefab only once per flow; writes created, flow and success.

destroy.desc: Called when the node is destroyed: forgets the objects.
